description: Top real traders on Polymarket CLOB V2 by volume or trade count, with the exchange contracts excluded. Use this rather than querying accounts directly: the V2 exchange is itself the `taker` when an order matches the book, so it accumulates an Account row and outranks every human by an order of magnitude. V2-era only (from block 84902353).
name: get_v2_top_traders
